WITH wo AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
lines AS (
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type, 'sale' AS kind, f.net_amount AS amt
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN wo ON wo.web_order_id=f.receipt_id JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wo.dispatch_date
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, wo.fulfilment_type, CASE WHEN rs.store_id=900 THEN 'ret900' ELSE 'retstore' END, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store rs ON rs.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id JOIN dim_store ss ON ss.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN wo ON wo.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.return_date
  WHERE ss.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fulfilment_type, kind, round(sum(amt),2) amt, count(*) n
FROM lines WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period IN (9,10)
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

WITH wo AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')),
n AS (
  SELECT wo.dispatch_date AS bd, f.net_amount AS sb, 0 AS rt, f.net_amount AS ns
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN wo ON wo.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, 0, r.refund_net, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test')
SELECT d.fiscal_period, round(sum(sb),2) mine_before, round(sum(rt),2) mine_ret, round(sum(ns),2) mine_net,
 (SELECT round(sum(net_sales_before_returns),2) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) rpt_before,
 (SELECT round(sum(returns_net),2) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) rpt_ret,
 (SELECT round(sum(net_sales),2) FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d2 ON d2.calendar_date=r.business_date WHERE r.store_id=900 AND d2.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d2.fiscal_period=d.fiscal_period) rpt_net
FROM n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.bd WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9,10) GROUP BY d.fiscal_period ORDER BY 1

WITH wo AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, fulfilment_type,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
web_net AS (
    -- web sales lines (store 900) on the Helsinki dispatch date
    SELECT wo.dispatch_date AS business_date, wo.fulfilment_type, f.net_amount AS net_sales, f.net_amount AS sales_before_returns
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    -- refunds booked to the web shop (store 900), on the return date, typed by the original order
    SELECT r.return_date, wo.fulfilment_type, -r.refund_net, 0
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id = r.sales_line_id
    JOIN wo ON wo.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN w.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN w.net_sales ELSE 0 END), 2) AS cc_net,
       ROUND(SUM(w.net_sales), 2) AS web_net,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN w.net_sales ELSE 0 END) / SUM(w.net_sales), 2) AS cc_share_pct,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.fulfilment_type = 'click_and_collect' THEN w.sales_before_returns ELSE 0 END) / SUM(w.sales_before_returns), 2) AS cc_share_before_returns_pct
FROM web_net w
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period IN (9, 10)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
